title: Samples on which a coefficient array vanishes
statement: Let $n$, $\ell$, and $m$ be nonnegative integers, and let $c$ be a low-degree coefficient array indexed by subsets of $[n]$ of size at most $\ell$. The associated miss set consists of all sequences of $m$ points of $\mathbb F_2^n$ at which the evaluation of $c$ is zero at every sample.
caveat: The supplied snippet omits the definition of the evaluation map and coefficient arrays.
